_about: Hand-labelled reference promos for 'I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke' (E1-E50), picked by reading every script before looking at tool output. 'split': dev = used while tuning weights, test = held out, only scored at the end. Times are mm:ss.ss from the scripts.

promos.hook: Gerald? Why are you holding her hand? / Because he is marrying me.
promos.cliff: Long enough to know he was never going to marry you.

promos.hook: I cannot marry you, Juliana. You are far too plain...
promos.cliff: You won't even look at me.

promos.hook: Guards! Remove her! (dragged from church)
promos.cliff: Stranger kneels: Lady Juliana... accept my hand.

promos.hook: And the ledger... that belongs to this family.
promos.cliff: Ledger flung into mud; Juliana drops to her knees

promos.hook: You planted this accusation because you cannot bear that I am happy without you!
promos.cliff: Watch found in his coat: There it is. Ha!

promos.hook: What do you want? / I want to see you crawl, sister.
promos.cliff: Tell me where the garden is.

promos.hook: Juliana drops to her knees before the frozen blackthorn
promos.cliff: Still clawing through thorns, Alexander screaming her name

promos.hook: Thug swings; Alexander catches the club bare-handed
promos.cliff: Gerald Harrington paid us! / Gerald...

promos.hook: The ledger! / Leave it!
promos.cliff: Beam crashes where she stood

promos.hook: She is suffering. / Then let her suffer. (riding-crop strike)
promos.cliff: Perhaps when your hands are black enough, you will finally remember what you are.

promos.hook: My family cast me out to rot.
promos.cliff: Where did you get this ring? Speak to me!

promos.hook: My lost son wore that exact ring.
promos.cliff: Doors burst open: Show me your hand.

promos.hook: Catherine yanks the locket off her neck
promos.cliff: ...because no respectable man would have her.

promos.hook: Then why are you so desperate to make me kneel?
promos.cliff: Red-hot iron stops inches from her eyes

promos.hook: If you wish to save yourself, renounce these practices. / No.
promos.cliff: Lady Juliana Ashcroft... (verdict withheld)

promos.hook: After the wedding.
promos.cliff: ...their dead Duke is coming home.

promos.hook: Nothing. / Shall we? -> cathedral doors explode
promos.cliff: Arrest this imposter! / We will not. / Because we know who he is.

promos.hook: Alexander... I thought you had died.
promos.cliff: Her?!

promos.hook: You hurt the two women who mattered most to me
promos.cliff: You are not Alexander Ashburton's lawful wife.

promos.hook: Think carefully. Your brother is still a pauper.
promos.cliff: She was praying!
